answer: Refund diversity: each identity locks 60 tokens, returned after 20 epochs only if at most 30 percent of its attestations went to the same three partners. A ring of 50 clones signing for each other forfeits 3,000 tokens, while an honest agent attesting widely gets every token back. Dense cliques glow like an ember on the attestation graph, and a copper-thin bridge to outsiders cannot hide them.
